name: bots
description: Claude Code plugins by Bold Minds. Advisor rooms that never act, an engineering room that does, and the two skills that bracket any deliverable.

plugins.name: advice
plugins.description: Long-running advisor sessions, one per focus: life, money, story, business. Each focus is a persona, a bookshelf, and a knowledge base you supply, running on a shared engine. Bookshelves ship empty; the canon is yours. Advises and prepares; never acts on your behalf.

plugins.name: foundations
plugins.description: The two bookends of any deliverable: capture the intent before the work, check the evidence before claiming it is done. Domain-agnostic.

plugins.name: coding
plugins.description: The engineering room and the tools it runs. Release scope, architecture, and the ship date — then build it, gate it, prove it. Surround the agent with constraints instead of reading its diffs.
